background.prompt: 失焦、带动态模糊的复古胶片照片：黄昏空荡的旧火车站台，一个人站着，身体向左右拖出两道残影。

lines.zh: 你所浪费的今天，是昨天死去的人所奢望的明天。
lines.en: The today you waste is the tomorrow those who died yesterday longed for.

lines.zh: 你所厌恶的现在，是未来的你回不到的曾经。
lines.en: The present you resent is the past your future self can never return to.

lines.zh: 人这一生最奇怪的，莫过于总是活在自己不愿待在的时间里。
lines.en: The strangest thing in life is that we always live in a time we don't want to be in.

lines.zh: 很多时候，我们人坐在这里，心却在别处。
lines.en: So often, we sit here, but our minds are elsewhere.

lines.zh: 吃饭时想着工作，陪家人时，又在回一条消息。
lines.en: Thinking of work while eating; answering a message while with family.

lines.zh: 因为人最难待住的，往往不是某个地方，而是此刻。
lines.en: What's hardest to stay in is often not a place, but this moment.

lines.zh: 心理学中有一个概念，叫做心智游移。
lines.en: Psychology has a concept called mind-wandering.

lines.zh: 它指的是注意力不由自主地离开眼前的事。
lines.en: It means attention drifts away from what's in front of us on its own.

lines.zh: 2010年，哈佛的基林斯沃思和吉尔伯特，
lines.en: In 2010, Killingsworth and Gilbert at Harvard

lines.zh: 随机询问了两千多人，此刻在想什么。
lines.en: randomly asked over two thousand people what they were thinking right then.

lines.zh: 发现人们将近一半的时间，都没在想眼前的事；
lines.en: They found people spent nearly half their time not thinking about what they were doing,

lines.zh: 而走神的时候，人普遍更不快乐。
lines.en: and when their minds wandered, they were generally less happy.

lines.zh: 也就是说，让我们不快乐的，未必是此刻本身，
lines.en: In other words, what makes us unhappy may not be the moment itself,

lines.zh: 而是我们总在离开此刻。
lines.en: but that we keep leaving it.

lines.zh: 三百多年前，帕斯卡就写过：
lines.en: Over three hundred years ago, Pascal wrote:

lines.zh: 我们从不停留在现在，
lines.en: we never keep to the present,

lines.zh: 所以我们从未生活，只是希望生活。
lines.en: so we never live, but only hope to live.

lines.zh: 可我们总以为，等以后条件好了，再好好生活。
lines.en: Yet we always think we'll really live once things get better.

lines.zh: 于是今天被用来等待明天，明天又被用来怀念今天。
lines.en: So today is spent waiting for tomorrow, and tomorrow is spent missing today.

lines.zh: 我一直觉得，人最容易错过的，不是远方，
lines.en: I've always felt what we miss most easily isn't somewhere far away,

lines.zh: 而是那些当时觉得平常、后来再也回不去的日子。
lines.en: but the days that felt ordinary then and can never be returned to.

lines.zh: 当然，活在当下不是不管未来，也不是假装没有过去；
lines.en: Of course, living in the present doesn't mean ignoring the future, or pretending there was no past;

lines.zh: 而是在想着明天的时候，记得自己还站在今天。
lines.en: it means remembering you're still standing in today while thinking of tomorrow.

lines.zh: 所以不必急着逃离现在，
lines.en: So don't rush to escape the present.

lines.zh: 它也许并不完美，
lines.en: It may not be perfect,

lines.zh: 但它是你唯一能真正活着的时间。
lines.en: but it's the only time you can truly be alive.
